description: Post to the user's Discord server. Free. With the Hermoso bot added it posts as the bot to channel (or the brand's default channel) with attachments up to 25 MB a message, replyTo, threadId (inside a thread), startThread (a thread under the post) and threadName (a forum channel); the messageId it returns ("<channel>/<message>") is what edit, delete and get_discord_message take. Without the bot it posts through the brand's announcement webhook (never the alert one): ≤2000 characters, files up to 20 MB attached (up to 10), larger ones as links. Mentions never ping unless mentions:true. Reactions are the only per-post number (get_discord_message). Not connected: connect_connector with provider discord and no fields returns the install link.

allowDuplicate.description: post it even though an identical post was just made

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Beats the connection's pin for THIS CALL ONLY; a name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

channel.description: HERMOSO BOT: channel id or #name (list_discord_channels); unset = the default channel

discordServer.description: HERMOSO BOT: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

idempotencyKey.description: any stable string: a repeat within 24h returns the original post instead of posting again

imageUrls.description: up to 10 files in one message

mentions.description: let @everyone / @here / role mentions ping people (off by default)

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

replyTo.description: HERMOSO BOT: reply to this message id

startThread.description: HERMOSO BOT: start a thread under the new post with this title

threadId.description: HERMOSO BOT: post inside this existing thread

threadName.description: required when the channel is a FORUM channel: the new thread title

username.description: webhook posts only: a different display name than the webhook's own

name: post_to_discord
title: Post a Discord announcement
